title: Preciptancy
summary: PRECIP'TANCY, noun [from precipitant.] Headlong hurry; rash haste; haste in resolving, forming an opinion or executing a purpose without due deliberation. Hurried on by the precipitance of youth. Rash

inlines.v: PRECIP'TANCY, noun [from precipitant.] Headlong hurry; rash haste; haste in resolving, forming an opinion or executing a purpose without due deliberation. Hurried on by the precipitance of youth. Rashness and precipitance of judgment. 1. Hurry; great haste in going.
